verdict.rationale: macOS shows some programmatic surfaces beyond the GUI: Shortcuts for automating tasks, Siri AI taking actions in apps, and command-line utilities such as pbcopy/pbpaste, networkQuality and fs_usage that users cite as replacements for GUI workflows. Nothing in the evidence shows that UI capabilities are generally exposed through an API, and the OpenAPI probes found no machine-readable API spec. Missing for 10: evidence of UI-to-API parity, a documented automation or scripting API covering system and app functions, a machine-readable API spec, and independent confirmation that UI actions can be performed programmatically.
